## Type of Change

- [ ] feat — New feature
- [ ] fix — Bug fix
- [ ] security — Security fix
- [ ] refactor — Code refactoring
- [ ] perf — Performance improvement
- [ ] docs — Documentation
- [ ] test — Tests
- [ ] chore — Maintenance / dependencies / config
- [ ] release — Release preparation
- [ ] hotfix — Emergency production fix

## Breaking Change

- [ ] No — this change is backward compatible
- [ ] Yes — this change breaks existing functionality

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows convention (`feature/`, `fix/`, `security/`, etc.)
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): description`)
- [ ] Code passes all CI checks (lint, typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
- [ ] Tests added for new functionality
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (if user-facing change)
